تعادلت (form VI)
# تَعَادَلْتُ (taʕādaltu) /ta.ʕaː.dal.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَعَادَلَ (taʕādala)
# تَعَادَلْتَ (taʕādalta) /ta.ʕaː.dal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَعَادَلَ (taʕādala)
# تَعَادَلْتِ (taʕādalti) /ta.ʕaː.dal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَعَادَلَ (taʕādala)
# تَعَادَلَتْ (taʕādalat) /ta.ʕaː.da.lat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
